item.title: MUSC Health purchases Palmetto Primary Care Physicians in $111 million acquisition
item.description: CHARLESTON, S.C. (WCBD) - The Medical University Hospital Authority Board of Trustees voted unanimously to purchase all membership interests in Palmetto Primary Care Physicians, effective on March 3. MUHA, part of Medical University of South Carolina Health, has moved forward with the acquisition, purchasing PPCP for $111 million. PPCP is South Carolina's largest independent multispecialty [...]
